stem.text: Which does **not** occur when a red blood cell arrives at the alveolus?

A.text: Carbaminohaemoglobin releases carbon dioxide from the $\alpha$-globin and $\beta$-globin polypeptide chains.

B.text: Carbonic acid in the red blood cell forms carbon dioxide and water.

C.text: Hydrogencarbonate ions diffuse from the plasma into the red blood cell.

D.text: Hydrogen ions are released from haemoglobinic acid and diffuse out of the red blood cell.
